scripts.build: cmd /c "if exist build ( rd /s /q build )" & cmd /c "mkdir build" & cmd /c "robocopy . build server.js package.json package-lock.json" & cmd /c "robocopy .\config build\config /E" & cmd /c "robocopy .\controllers build\controllers /E" & cmd /c "robocopy .\middlewares build\middlewares /E" & cmd /c "robocopy .\models build\models /E" & cmd /c "robocopy .\routes build\routes /E" & cmd /c "robocopy .\utils build\utils /E" & cmd /c "cd build && npm install --production"
